system.description:
Favoured weapon: Sickle

Granted power: Advantage on Wisdom checks in natural environments. Once/day, when your Smite hits, roots burst up around the target: it and each enemy within 10ft of it make a Fortitude save or are Restrained for 1 minute.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Chauntea in the World of Arneyan wiki.
